independence_evidence: The site describes Wunderdog as 'a new independent dog magazine' and the footer copyright names the publisher as Paw Print London Ltd, a small company with no group parent (https://wunderdogmagazine.com/).
qualifies_reason: An independently published print magazine whose Issue 10 (124 pages) went on sale in December 2025, although the publisher says it 'may be our last issue' in print.
what_it_is: Wunderdog is a British magazine about rescue dogs and dog welfare, telling the stories of adopted dogs and the people around them. Issues combine long interviews with campaigners and charities, photo essays, travel pieces on dog-friendly places, and reports on street dogs abroad, alongside a shop of posters and dog accessories. It is for dog owners and adopters who want a campaigning, photography-led read rather than training or breed advice.
